destination.instructions: Independently find where the pair currently on F belongs. Compare pairColors.F with each center. Return the face whose center has that color, or none if pairColors.F is mixed. Do not choose a turn and do not read sibling answers.

criteria.F: The center on F matches pairColors.F.

turn.instructions: Choose the upper-face rotation that carries currentPosition to requiredPosition. Source and destination are an ordered pair. Choose leave if they are the same or requiredPosition is none.

criteria.U: Quarter turn: front to left; left to back; back to right; right to front.
criteria.U': Quarter turn: front to right; right to back; back to left; left to front.
criteria.U2: Half turn: front to back, back to front, left to right, or right to left.
criteria.leave: No rotation: same source/destination or destination none.

steps.alg: U2

intention.instructions: pairCount is the number of sides whose two upper-corner stickers have the same color. Use pairCount to choose the operation family. With pairCount=0 or 1 choose permute. With pairCount=4 compare each pair color to its own center: all match means done, otherwise align.

criteria.align: pairCount=4, and at least one pair color differs from its own center.
criteria.done: pairCount=4, and each pair color equals its own center.

reference.instructions: Independently assume a T permutation is needed. Choose the front that places the matching pair on local LEFT. If no pair exists or all four exist, any reference is acceptable. Do not read sibling answers.
